name: components/virtual-scroll-area
description: A data-driven virtualization primitive built on TanStack Virtual for rendering large datasets with smooth scrolling. Supports vertical, horizontal, and two-axis grid virtualization, fixed or dynamic sizing, and incremental load-more callbacks when approaching boundaries.
useCases: Render long activity or log streams with dynamic row heights
Build horizontally virtualized timelines or dense chip lanes
Display two-axis grids with large row and column counts
Implement infinite scrolling with reactive row or column counts
